answer_1.quote: To generate explanations for MODEL-EXPL, we used GPT-3.5 prompted to generate SBF-style explanations...

answer_4.quote: A total of N =454 participants recruited from Amazon MTurk are randomly assigned to one of the four conditions... Upon completion, participants also complete a post-study survey which collects... subjective feedback on the moderation task and provided explanations (if any).
